messages:
Nora: quick heads-up: eu-west3 attach tail spiked. small subset of scratch nodes showing NVMe background-scrub escalation tied to temp rise.
Ben: which nodes/pool?
Nora: pool=cohort-F (gnode-eu3-40[1-2]). Firmware kicked a full scrub when temp hit ~66C, background IO shot up. Attaches are queuing and autoscaler misreports free capacity.
Ibrahim: any SMARTs/read errors?
Nora: none yet. just high write-amplification and io_wait causing attach retries. sample dmesg: ```
[ 7890.123] nvme0: temp=66C fw=fw-2025-14 scrub escalated full-scan
[ 7891.456] nvme0: write_amp=2.9->5.0 io_wait=320ms
```
Priya: mitigation options?
Nora: immediate: throttle janitor for cohort-F (concurrency=1, cap io to 50%), reduce router weight for gnode-eu3-40* to 0.02, and schedule a staggered scrub window overnight. Longer-term: vendor ticket for fw-2025-14 and staging rollback test.
Ben: agree. small region preference shift beats sustained attach tail. what's cost vs SLA hit?
Priya: small latency bump (~10-25ms) and slight internal egress cost if we shift traffic. I'll calc 24h delta for postmortem.
Nora: applying changes now. commands: ```
# throttle janitor
jq '.pools["cohort-F"].concurrency=1 | .pools["cohort-F"].max_io_bytes=0.5' /etc/janitor/config.yaml > /tmp/janitor.patch && sudo mv /tmp/janitor.patch /etc/janitor/config.yaml && sudo systemctl reload janitor
# deprioritize nodes in router
redis-cli HSET router:node_weights "gnode-eu3-40" 0.02
```
janitor-bot: updated janitor config for cohort-F (concurrency=1, max_io_bytes=50%). rolling apply ~60s.
Nora: router tweak live. tail latency down ~35% in 2m. opening vendor ticket INF-4622 with logs and dmesg.
Ibrahim: add a gradual ramp-back cron: if temp <60C for 30m, set concurrency=2; if <56C for 60m, restore. Also run fw rollback in staging on a spare node.
Ben: tagging eng-runtime and infra-owners on INF-4622. Thanks team.
Nora: will follow up if any SMARTs or readonly flips appear. :thumbsup:
